items.title: California’s Billionaire Tax Is Officially on the Ballot. Here’s How Much of the National Debt 100% of Every American Billionaire’s Wealth Would Actually Cover.
items.summary: California just certified the country's first statewide billionaire wealth tax for the 2026 ballot, and the fight over Proposition 40 has already cost opponents more than $107 million and sent some billionaires fleeing the state.
